proposals.evidence: DEDR 3633 gives Tamil/Malayalam nā/nākku/nāvu, Kannada nālige/nālage, Telugu/Konda nālika, Kolami nālka and Gadaba nāŋ ‘tongue’. These simple n-initial stems fit the documented series; Gondi vanjēr and Kurukh tatxa require different articles. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
